steps.title: Transfer volumes from source columns
steps.instruction: For each group of four source columns (columns 1‑4, 5‑8, etc.) across the four 96‑well deepwell plates, aspirate 20 µL from the first and fourth columns of the group and 2 µL from the second and third columns, then dispense the combined 44 µL into the corresponding destination well of the 96‑well PCR plate. Change tips after completing each group.

substeps.instruction: Identify a set of four source columns (e.g., columns 1‑4).
Aspirate 20 µL from column 1 of the set.
Aspirate 2 µL from column 2 of the set.
Aspirate 2 µL from column 3 of the set.
Aspirate 20 µL from column 4 of the set.
Dispense the total volume into the starting destination well of the PCR plate.
Discard the tip and use a new tip for the next set.

steps.title: Repeat for all column sets
steps.instruction: Repeat the transfer described in Step 1 for each subsequent group of four source columns, each time targeting the next destination column in the PCR plate, until all desired sets have been processed.
